name: HR employee assistance policy example
answer:
Employees may request up to six confidential counseling sessions each year.
Employees may use the program for any personal or work-related concern without an eligibility review.
The company pays for unlimited family therapy sessions.

sources.title: HR Employee Assistance Policy
sources.content:
Employees may request up to six confidential counseling sessions each year through the employee assistance program.
The program supports personal and work-related concerns, subject to the provider's eligibility and confidentiality rules.
Additional sessions may be approved when clinically appropriate.
